name: Cuyahoga Valley National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets are allowed on over 100 miles of trails and the Towpath Trail.
summary: Leashed pets are allowed on over 100 miles of trails and the Towpath Trail.

excerpts.quote: Dogs can go on most of the trails in the park, but they must remain on a leash.

dogRules.text: No pets on the East Rim mountain bike trails.
No pets at Virginia Kendall Hills during sledding.
Only service animals in buildings and on the scenic railroad.
